breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained contradictory boundary conditions: both Dirichlet (u=0 on all edges) and periodic. The ground truth resolved this by removing the periodic condition. The agent's generated specification correctly identified and fixed this error by only including the Dirichlet condition: 'Use Dirichlet boundary conditions with u=0 on all boundaries.'
